decisions.reason: Setting an interactive-field label to Danish does not change the document's English default-language configuration.
The candidate requires interactive-field labels to exist; their Danish language is independently represented by the source Requirement and does not alter that existence requirement.
The label-language decision does not change whether a field's placeholder clears when activated.
Changing a field label's language does not change the required editable-text representation or architecture quality.
The source decision concerns label language, not the visual cue used to identify editable fields.
The source does not change the calendar-dropdown method required for date fields.
Interactive-field label localization does not affect legacy-content transfer or formatting stability.
The label-language decision does not affect pasted table layout or column containment.
The source does not change bullet sizing, balance, alignment, color, or visual reference.
Changing an interactive-field label to Danish does not modify the required theme-color palette.
The source decision does not change Tab-based list hierarchy or nested-level alignment.
The source concerns interactive-field label language, not heading, title, image-caption, or table-caption typography.
